final: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor AS a LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id), shares AS (SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film) AS film_fraction FROM actor_counts) SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_fraction, film_fraction - AVG(film_fraction) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM shares ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, actor_id LIMIT 10
